summary: CMB.TECH NV filed a Form 6-K attaching a press release announcing a commercial charter agreement with Fortescue for up to 12 ammonia-capable bulkers. No financial terms, equity stake, tender offer, or acquisition/divestiture are disclosed. This is a routine operating contract, not a special situation under the defined categories. The filing merely reports a business development for informational purposes under Rule 13a-16.
